_comment: The league roster allowlist — the only people who can sign in.
Fill in emails as you collect them and re-run: npm run seed:members
The script is keyed on managerKey, so re-running updates rows in place
rather than creating duplicates, and skips entries with a blank email.
managerKey values are verified against edw.dim_manager on every run; the
script aborts if a name no longer matches, which is the tripwire for the
Python ETL renumbering a key underneath us.
